notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nmap scan of IMAP (143/993) and POP3 (110/995) ports with -sC flag automatically extracts SSL certificate details from TLS ports. Certificate common name and email addresses provide infrastructure intelligence without authenticating.

=== CHAINING ===
Port scan reveals IMAP/POP3 → cert extraction gives internal hostname + admin email → enumerate auth methods → attempt login with discovered credentials → curl imaps:// for folder listing → openssl interactive session for mail reading.
